overview: The School Committee reviewed district-wide academic initiatives, facility repairs, and the progress of the high school building project. Key actions included approving a revised capital plan and updating the school calendar following winter closures.

items.title: Call to Order and Good of the Order
items.summary: Member Graham announced that the MASC Day on the Hill was moved to March 30th to allow for more effective lobbying.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine items including bills, payrolls, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and meeting minutes.

items.title: Mustang Moment: McGlynn Elementary
items.summary: Students and Principal Andrew O'Brien presented their experiences with ST Math, an online program that uses visual puzzle-solving to teach mathematical concepts.

items.title: District Update: Personnel and Calendar
items.summary: The Superintendent announced the retirement of Student Services Director Joan Bowen and updated the district calendar due to snow days, setting the final day of school for June 24.

items.title: District Update: Academics and Instruction
items.summary: Dr. Kimberly Talbot introduced 'Mustang University,' a new professional development portal, and detailed participation in a state network to accelerate ELA instruction.

items.title: District Update: Operations and Facilities
items.summary: Kenneth Lord provided updates on elementary school roof and HVAC projects, including the receipt of over $1.7 million in utility rebates and the near-completion of district security upgrades.

items.title: MSBA Update: High School Building Project
items.summary: Member Graham reported the submission of the preliminary design program to the MSBA and discussed the upcoming process to narrow 29 building options down to a short list.

items.title: Revised Capital Plan
items.summary: Approved a revised capital plan that includes specific priority rankings as requested by the Collins Center for citywide planning.

items.title: Condolence
items.summary: The committee observed a moment of silence for Marta J. McNulty McGowan, a 40-year veteran of the Medford Public Schools.
